title: Random Disclosure Costs: A Unified Theory of Disclosure
abstract: arXiv:2610.27627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a unified framework for a class of evidence games in which a sender, seeking to increase posterior expectations (e.g., a market price), chooses whether to reveal or withhold her information. Our model nests several classic models, including type-dependent disclosure costs or benefits, uncertain information endowment, and the market for lemons. Frictions are captured as random disclosure costs that are privately known to the sender and noisily inferred by the receiver. We derive a simple characterization of the equilibrium and show that it features increasing disclosure for lower frictions or greater fundamental uncertainty. Further, with high uncertainty or low frictions, greater uncertainty about disclosure costs decreases the likelihood of disclosure. translated_title: 随机披露成本：一个统一的披露理论
translated_abstract: 我们为一系列证据博弈提出了一个统一的框架，在这类博弈中，试图提高后验预期（例如市场价格）的信息发送者选择是披露还是隐瞒其信息。我们的模型涵盖了多个经典模型，包括类型依赖的披露成本或收益、不确定的信息禀赋以及柠檬市场。摩擦被刻画为随机的披露成本，这些成本由发送者私人知晓，而接收者只能通过带噪声的推断来估计。我们推导出了均衡的简单刻画，并表明当摩擦较低或基本不确定性较大时，披露水平会上升。此外，在不确定性较高或摩擦较低的情况下，披露成本的不确定性越大，披露的可能性反而越低。正的披露成本并不一定排除向完全披露的完全揭示（unraveling），尤其是在结果分布具有厚尾或披露成本并非恒定时。最后，我们展示了……
tldr: 该论文以发送者私人知晓、接收者带噪声推断的随机披露成本来刻画摩擦，提出了一个能统一涵盖类型依赖披露成本、不确定信息禀赋和柠檬市场等经典模型的证据博弈框架，并给出均衡的简洁刻画，揭示了披露随摩擦、基本不确定性和成本异质性变化的规律。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified evidence-game framework in which frictions are modeled as privately known random disclosure costs noisily inferred by the receiver, nesting classic models such as type-dependent disclosure costs, uncertain information endowment, and the market for lemons, and providing a simple equilibrium characterization of how disclosure varies with frictions, fundamental uncertainty, and cost heterogeneity.
